column1: # Classification of every post, for deciding what moves to CIunit.
#   paper      Writes up or announces a specific peer-reviewed paper (usually Ken's own).

#              explainers, analyses, critiques, lectures. Good CIunit candidates.
#   practice   About how research works - publishing, reproducibility, careers, choosing
#              problems, science communication. Could go either way.
#   personal   Personal, cultural, political or humorous. Stays on the blog.
# These are judgment calls; the paper/science and science/practice boundaries are fuzzy.
